Data.purpose: Recadrer le framework après l'ajout de nombreux modules afin de restaurer une source de vérité unique, une composition explicite, des thèmes globaux, des métadonnées normées et une auto-documentation maintenable.
implemented: canonical framework manifest and single-version rule
metadata V2 with artifact version, introduced_in, schema, visibility and runtime modes
schema registry and schemas for common artifacts, components, modules and themes
cross-registry validation contract plus executable Python validator
public/dev experience axis independent from static/local/production runtime
composition engine and primitive reuse rules
log console refactored to compose floating_window
canonical theme registry and palette registry
theme-neutral runtime engine and generic palette deriver
Shadow Sage palette runtime reduced to compatibility shim
button templates bound to semantic design tokens
toolbar refactored to consume button IDs only
button and icon registries migrated to metadata V2
feedback components migrated to central buttons and semantic tokens
Data.next_safe_extension_rule: New feature packs must register schemas/components/providers/tokens and pass governance validation before being marked stable.

dictionnaire_donnees.note: Snapshot de release; ne remplace jamais framework-manifest.json.
